messages:
rachel_s: quick FYI — rolled kite-mini int4 to 8% canary on dedicated-b and parse failures for funcalls climbed from 0.3% -> 2.6% in last 45m.

rachel_s: snapshot: total invocations 12.4k, parse_fail 320, top route /v1/chat/invoke-tool. median resp tokens 64.

tom_b: any obvious class of malform? missing brace, truncated, extra punctuation?

rachel_s: mostly partial arrays and truncated endings. example mirror snippet: ```[{"cmd":"read"}, {"cmd":"stat"}  ```  <-- missing closing bracket.

samir: int4 PTQ recently used groupwise scale + per-channel bias fold, run id ptq-2026-02-27-v7. Could be nudging punctuation logits.

jess_y: tokenizer diff looks OK, but I see a CR inserted before the JSON chunk in several traces (token 58 boundary). That newline seems to be interpreted as separator during chunk concat.

tom_b: batching config on dedicated-b? we enabled batch_merge=true last week. that coalescing could create boundary artifacts.

samir: agree — hypothesis = int4 rounding + batch_merge concat -> partial suffix lost or extra separators.

rachel_s: plan: 1) pause canary growth to 5%, 2) flip batch_merge=false on pool, 3) enable json_healer postprocess on mirror and live for a short window, 4) gather 1k mirror traces and run json-lint diff vs fp16 baseline.

jess_y: I'll export 200 failing traces + logits to s3://redwood-infer/kite/onboard/6270000011/ and tag ptq run.

infra-bot: action queued: set canary_percent=5 for kite-mini int4 on dedicated-b per rachel_s.

samir: I'll run the fuzz harness with batch sizes {1,4,8} and batch_merge toggle. ETA ~90m for first signals.

rachel_s: cheers — will reconvene once fuzz results in. keeping this thread as the handoff for SRE/product. :thumbsup:
